parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: The lens is a cylindrical optical component made of glass, located at the front of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It focuses light onto the camera sensor or film to capture images.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for focusing or zooming depending on the camera design.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A plastic button located on the top of the camera, typically used as the shutter button.
parts.Functional_description: It triggers the camera to take a photo when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary plastic button on the top surface of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It may control power, mode selection, or other camera functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another small plastic button located near the top or side of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a menu or function control button.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the top or back of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It may be used for zoom, playback, or other secondary functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when pressed and returns to its original position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the camera made of aluminum alloy.
parts.Functional_description: It houses all internal components, provides structural integrity, and supports external parts like the lens and buttons.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, rigid part that does not move during normal operation.
